en: Oh, Shuichi...

Ah, Ryoma. Are you headed to
the dining hall?

Hmph...if I went there the way I am now, 
I'd just ruin the mood...

Listen... I can't even begin to imagine
what your life has been like...
And I know that this is going to sound cliche, but...

You shouldn't give up on life. If you keep
living...I'm sure good things will happen.
Good things, huh?

Good things...are when your wishes, 
hopes, or dreams are fulfilled, right?

What does that have to do with someone
like me with no wishes, hopes, or dreams?
But—

More importantly...did something happen
to you?
...Huh?

You haven't noticed? You look completely 
different from yesterday.

It's like your eyes have stopped focusing on the
past... Hmph, your face looks more dependable.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma's speech was low and melancholy.
He turned and walked away.
Stopped focusing on the past...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.
